summary_1line: Ravana descends to the nether regions, battles the Nivatakavachas and later the sons of Varuna, forming an alliance and displaying overwhelming martial power.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana in the flying Pushpaka chariot battles the radiant sons of Varuna amid a storm of arrows in the sky.
Ravana circumambulates the miraculous cow Surabha whose endless milk flows into the cosmic ocean.
Mahodara smashes the airborne chariots of Varuna’s sons with a massive mace, sending them crashing to the earth.
